name: Elika
overview: Elika is a male figure known as the Harodite and is identified as the ninth member of "the thirty," a distinguished group of David's warriors. There is no record of his tribal affiliation or additional notes about his life in Scripture. His mention is brief but marks him as part of David's elite military band.
namesAndTitles: The only name recorded is Elika, with no specific meaning or divine origin noted in Scripture. His name appears solely in 2 Samuel 23:25 without further explanation.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Elika beyond his designation as the Harodite and member of David's thirty mighty men.
scriptureSignificance: Elika's significance lies in his role as one of David's thirty mighty men, a group known for their bravery and loyalty. Being the ninth among this elite band highlights his standing as a trusted warrior during David's reign. Though details are sparse, his inclusion in this list underscores his contribution to David's military successes.
